blocks.text: This page tracks the Mission MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $797,500 for a typical home, down 11.6% over twelve months.
Mission benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Mission home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $797,500 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.4% on the month, down 4.8% over three months, down 5.9% over six months and down 11.6% over the year. Over three years it is down 16.7%, and over five years down 12.6%.
The weakest one-year move in Mission was for a detached home homes at −13.3%; the strongest was a townhouse at −4.1%.
The gap between a detached home ($889,200) and an apartment ($411,500) is $477,700, and a townhouse ($618,000) sits $206,500 above the apartment benchmark.
Against the Fraser Valley Board area, where the all-home benchmark was $861,300, Mission is 7.4% below. Over the year the Fraser Valley Board area moved down 7.2% against down 11.6% here.
Of the 8 areas this board reports, Mission ranks 6 by all-home benchmark, with Surrey above it at $906,200 and Abbotsford below it at $701,900.

Detached homes in Mission: benchmark $889,200, little changed at −0.4% in a month, down 5.6% in three months, down 6.9% in six months, down 13.3% in a year, down 14.2% in three years and down 10.6% in five. That is 31.6% below the detached benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($1,300,000).

Townhouse homes in Mission: benchmark $618,000, little changed at −0.6% in a month, down 4.3% in three months, down 4.9% in six months, down 4.1% in a year, down 5.2% in three years and up 5.2% in five. That is 17.1% below the townhouse benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($745,300).

Apartment homes in Mission: benchmark $411,500, little changed at −0.7% in a month, down 2.7% in three months, down 3.6% in six months, down 4.7% in a year, down 9.5% in three years and up 6.6% in five. That is 10.9% below the apartment benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($461,800).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Mission?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Mission home was $797,500, with detached at $889,200.

faq.q: Are Mission home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Mission is down 11.6% over twelve months and down 4.8% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
